## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior.

## Validation

Commands run, outcomes, and skipped coverage. For a regression fix, explain how the
test detects the bug. Include GPU/driver/CPU details when relevant.

## Tune contributions

If this adds a tune: use `cmt export`, keep its file unchanged at the printed path,
and confirm the export succeeded. Note other load, a VM, riser or power limit.
